text:
rajesh: starting a controlled apply for tenant-skybridge network+iam changes. canary in ap-southeast-1a only, 12m quiet window. provider pinned to v4.3.2+sha256:beefcafe. pls ack if you have active work on skybridge.
deploybot: plan kicked off: https://deploy.logs/infra/tenant-skybridge/plan/6188880000 :eyes:
deploybot: plan summary: 6 to change, 1 replace (aws_eip), risk: IAM policy tightening and eip swap timing.
marta: ack. I'll review the IAM diff; flag if wildcard grants appear.
oliver: we have a maintenance job touching routes in 40m. will delay that if this affects routing.
rajesh: noted, delaying other jobs. adding preflight backup check: `aws s3 ls s3://tf-backups/skybridge/6188880000.snapshot || exit 1`.
sec-oncall: scheduled IAM lint. webhook -> this thread.
opsbot: monitor tenant-skybridge-canary (p50, 5xx, route-failures) -> alerts to #incidents + here.
deploybot: preflight apply: `TF_WORKSPACE=skybridge TF_VAR_env=prod terraform apply -auto-approve -target=module.network -var-file=tenant-skybridge.tfvars`
rajesh: starting canary apply now in ap-southeast-1a. DO NOT merge provider changes into main during window.
deploybot: canary apply started 6188880020.
deploybot: canary apply finished 6188880035 — success. eip replaced, 1 iam policy tightened.
marta: IAM lint result: narrowed one assumeRole, removed a broad wildcard on s3:*. lgtm after confirmation.
rajesh: running smoke: BGP OK, instances have correct routes, eip attached.
oliver: routing looks good from our side.
rajesh: metrics check: p50 stable, 5xx 0.05%. proceeding to full rollout in two waves (ap-southeast-1b then ap-southeast-1c), 10m stagger.
sec-oncall: noted, will watch audit logs for privilege escalations.
rajesh: rollback plan: if route-failure >10% for 3m or 5xx >2% for 2m, revert using tfstate snapshot `terraform state replace-provider` and reapply previous snapshot. runbook: https://runbooks.internal/infra/skybridge/rollback
oliver: copying that. will pause my maintenance until green.
deploybot: wave1 started 6188880045.
deploybot: wave1 finished 6188880055 — no errors.
rajesh: holding between waves for 8m to validate. if anything odd, will abort and notify sec-oncall.
marta: attaching plan diffs to release ticket. adding release note: "tenant-skybridge: EIP swap + IAM policy tighten (canary ap-southeast-1a)" :memo:
rajesh: thanks. keeping thread open for 30m post-rollout for observation. reach here for approvals or rollbacks.
